resource.title: ECON 159 Game Theory (Ben Polak, Open Yale Courses) — 24 讲完整视频 + 讲义 + 习题
resource.covers: Open Yale Courses 免费提供全部 24 讲视频、讲义（transcript）与作业。官方 Description：dominance、backward induction、Nash equilibrium、evolutionary stability、commitment、credibility、asymmetric information、adverse selection、signaling；课程目录里还有 L11–12 Evolutionary Stability、L17 Backward Induction: Ultimatum and Bargaining、L24 Asymmetric Information: Auctions and the Winner's Curse。对应节点的均衡概念、序贯决策（逆向归纳/子博弈精炼）、效用与风险（预期效用讲）、多主体相互作用；机制设计（VCG、显示原理）与形式化决策理论只部分覆盖，D4 层需另补。

courses.prereq_text: Requirements: ... Introductory microeconomics (115 or equivalent) is required. Intermediate micro (150/2) is not required, but it is recommended. We will use calculus (mostly one variable) in this course. We will also refer to ideas like probability and expectation.

Prerequisites: A course in probability (6.041 or equivalent) and mathematical maturity. A course in analysis (18.100 or equivalent), and a course in optimization (6.251, 6.255 or equivalent) would be helpful, but is not required.

extra_prereqs.evidence: MIT 6.254：'A course in probability (6.041 or equivalent) and mathematical maturity' 为必修先修；Yale ECON 159 也写 'We will also refer to ideas like probability and expectation.'
Yale ECON 159：'We will use calculus (mostly one variable) in this course.'（用一元微分/最优化推理，但没写成一门先修课，故记 recommended）
MIT 6.254：'A course in analysis (18.100 or equivalent) ... would be helpful, but is not required.'
MIT 6.254：'a course in optimization (6.251, 6.255 or equivalent) would be helpful, but is not required.'

notes: 原图对 M.7.6 没列任何建议前置，故 candidate_check 为空，只写 extra_prereqs。资源选 Yale ECON 159（入门、全视频、免费、英文），MIT 6.254 作进阶对照：它把机制设计（VCG、显示原理、拍卖收益等价）讲全，适合 D3/D4。两门课的『先修』都在要求段落里写得很明确。映射说明：Yale 要求的 'Introductory microeconomics (115)' 在技能树里没有对应节点，故未映射；Yale 只用一元微积分（M.1.2），没有要求线性代数或证明课；MIT 6.254 的 'mathematical maturity' 无具体课程，未强行映射到 M.5.3。
